title: Shared search, risk, and context-pack payload helper family
problemStatement: Search-request argument shaping and risk/context-pack filter alias normalization were split across tools/shared/search-request.js, src/integrations/tooling/context-pack.js, tools/analysis/explain-risk.js, and tools/analysis/delta-risk.js. That left the canonical behavior tool-owned and duplicated cross-surface request/filter shaping in CLI, API, MCP, and retrieval-facing surfaces.

duplicateClusters.name: Search request payload shaping owned by tools/shared
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Move canonical search-request shaping into src/shared/search-request.js and reduce tools/shared/search-request.js to a compatibility wrapper so src/** and cross-surface consumers no longer depend on tool ownership.

duplicateClusters.name: Risk filter alias normalization duplicated across analysis/context-pack surfaces
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Add a shared buildRiskFilterInput helper in src/shared/risk-filters.js so snake_case, kebab-case, and camelCase risk filter aliases normalize identically across CLI, API, MCP, and context-pack surfaces.

whyCurrentSharedModulesWereInsufficient: src/shared/risk-filters.js normalized and validated risk filters, but did not own the alias-mapping step that several surfaces had already reimplemented.
tools/shared/search-request.js was already shared by multiple surfaces, but its ownership was wrong for src/** and cross-surface payload shaping.

migrationsCompleted.notes: Now owns canonical search payload normalization and CLI-argument shaping.
Now delegates to src/shared/search-request.js for compatibility.
Now owns shared risk filter input alias normalization through buildRiskFilterInput().

nonGoals: Replace the VS Code extension's local search-contract adapter in this issue.
Refactor result rendering or response-envelope formatting.
Move all analysis validation schemas into a single new module.
followOnDeletionTargets: Further reduce direct tool-side search-request imports where wrapper compatibility is no longer needed.
Continue hoisting other context-pack or risk payload builders if later H32 scans show more duplication.
